flows.title: Research chat journey (Next.js App Router)
flows.summary: Every request first passes HTTP Basic auth in proxy.ts. The home page lists research items and shows an empty chat. Sending the first message creates a session and silently rewrites the URL to /s/<id>, which can later be reopened to resume the conversation. 'New research' returns to /.

nodes.label: Open the app
nodes.description: The proxy runs on every route except eve/, _next/static and _next/image, so the browser first has to satisfy Basic auth.

nodes.label: Basic auth ok?
nodes.description: Compares the Authorization header with BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME/PASSWORD from the environment.

nodes.label: 401 + login prompt
nodes.description: Without valid credentials the browser shows its native Basic-auth dialog (WWW-Authenticate header, realm 'Pocket Research').

nodes.label: Home: empty chat + research list
nodes.description: Server component (force-dynamic) that loads research items and renders AgentChat without a sessionId.
nodes.snippet:
const researchItems = await listResearchItems();
  return <AgentChat researchItems={researchItems} />;

nodes.label: User sends a message
nodes.description: handleSubmit ignores empty input and input while resuming, then calls agent.send. If a turn is already running the message is sent with the 'steer' policy.

nodes.label: URL becomes /s/<id>
nodes.description: On the first session change the URL is rewritten with History.replaceState, not router navigation, because Next's navigation would detach the active stream.

nodes.label: Answer streams in
nodes.description: While the status is 'submitted' or 'streaming' the chat shows a thinking indicator and live messages.

nodes.label: User cancels
nodes.description: Calls agent.cancel(). If that fails, the error is shown in the chat.

nodes.label: Error message shown
nodes.description: Cancellation errors, agent errors and failed turns are all shown by ErrorMessage.
nodes.snippet: function ErrorMessage({ message }: { readonly message: string }) {

nodes.label: Reopen /s/<id>
nodes.description: The session page passes the id to AgentChat, which resumes the stream from index 0.

nodes.label: Click 'New research'
nodes.description: A full page load of / (window.location.assign), starting a fresh session.

notes: There is no router config or login page: the only 'screens' are / and /s/[sessionId], both rendering AgentChat.
What the agent does after agent.send (eve runtime, research tools) was not traced; this is the browser-side journey only.
app/_components/research-list.tsx (the clickable research items on the home page) was not read.
